verdict_basis: TEMPORARY_EXTERNAL_PATH_EXCEPTION production-seam RED+GREEN pinned at HEAD: temporaryExternalCanonicalRoots widens the R0 path-authority containment set under bounded, expiring, canonical-path-scoped, user-controlled conditions. Realpath-canonicalization closes the symlink escape; 24h hard ceiling; MIGRATION_OR_DEFAULT_AUTHORITY_DELTA = 0 for the absent-key category. CORRECTION03 cross-instance visibility is now achieved by reading the authority at the decision boundary (no watcher, no debounce, no event attribution, no chronology-based self-write heuristic). The factory reviewer's halt condition is closed: a real two-reader / one-backing-store test exercises the production fresh-read pipeline end-to-end (external write to disk → resolveActiveTemporaryExternalCanonicalRootsFromBackingFile reads → canonical roots returned), without touching the StateManager cache.

v1_contract.name: TEMPORARY_EXTERNAL_PATH_EXCEPTION
v1_contract.primary: user-enabled, expiring external-path exception + R0 read-only command + every operand realpath-contained inside the union of workspace roots and the temporary external canonical roots = ALLOW-eligible
v1_contract.subset_guarantee: This ACT only widens the R0 path-authority containment set; it never narrows it. A command that was ALLOW before remains ALLOW. A command that was ASK before this ACT remains ASK (the safe-rule engine is the gate to ALLOW; the temporary roots do not classify commands as safe).
fail_closed_contract: no temporaryExternalCanonicalRoots on the evidence (or empty)  => ASK (workspaceRoots only — pre-ACT behavior)
realpath resolution of the temporary root fails (ENOENT/EACCES/ELOOP) => entry INACTIVE
expiresAt in the past or now (now >= expiresAt)              => entry INACTIVE
operand realpath outside the UNION of roots + temp roots     => ASK
symlink at the temporary root pointing outside               => ASK (canonical escape closed)
host did not supply pathAuthorityEvidence                    => ASK (unchanged)
safe-rule did not match the command shape                   => ASK (unchanged)
reviewer_findings_closed: P0 (V1): R0 default authority unchanged when no entry is persisted (MIGRATION_OR_DEFAULT_AUTHORITY_DELTA = 0)
P0 (V1): symlink at temporary root is blocked (canonical realpath is the authority, not the lexical path)
P0 (V1): V1 authority-context binding (`auth.workspaceRoots === evidence.roots`) preserved byte-equal because the temporary roots are carried SEPARATELY, not mirrored into `evidence.roots`
P0 (V1): hard-DENY preserved (the temporary roots widen R0 path-authority; they do NOT authorize a hard-DENY command)
P1 (V1): expired entries are filtered structurally (UI cleanup is irrelevant; now >= expiresAt is INACTIVE)
P1 (V1): 24h hard ceiling is enforced on write (UI clamps; structural filter ignores stale entries anyway)
P1 (V1): cross-instance consistency via absolute ISO-8601 `expiresAt` (no relative-duration reset drift)
P1 (V1): Seatbelt unchanged (the temporary roots do not alter the Seatbelt filesystem profile)
P1 (V1): sensitive-file protections unchanged (the temporary roots are a separate authority class from sensitive-file deny)
P2 (V1): tamper-resistance in policy re-test (evaluateCommandRealpathConformance re-tests containment from canonical strings; a tampered `contained: true` on the host record is caught)
